questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-7\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\).
Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\).
If \(A\) has order 3 × 2 and \(B\) has order 5 × 4, what is the order of \(AB\)?
questions.explanation: AB is not defined: the columns of A (2) do not equal the rows of B (5).

questions.prompt: For a non-singular matrix A, the inverse is:
questions.explanation: Divide the adjoint by the determinant.

questions.prompt: If \(A\) has order 1 × 5 and \(B\) has order 5 × 5, what is the order of \(AB\)?
questions.explanation: AB is defined because the columns of A (5) equal the rows of B (5); the order is rows of A × columns of B = 1 × 5.

questions.prompt: If A is a 2×2 matrix with \(|A|=1\), find \(|5A|\).
questions.explanation: For an n×n matrix \(|kA|=k^{n}|A|\). Here n = 2: \(5^{2}\)(1) = 25.

questions.prompt: A is 2×2 with \(|A|=-1\). Find the (1,1) entry of \(A\operatorname{adj}A\).
questions.explanation: \(A\operatorname{adj}A=|A|I\), so the (1,1) entry is -1.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-6&-4\\0&6\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-6)6 - (-4)0=-36\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: Without expanding, find the value of \(\begin{vmatrix}3&9&4\\-3&-9&-4\\-7&-9&3\end{vmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: The determinant is 0 because the matrix has rows that are proportional (R2 = -1R1).

questions.prompt: Square matrices A and B of the same order have \(|A|=5\) and \(|B|=4\). Find \(|AB^{T}|\).
A is 2×2 with \(|A|=-2\). Find the (1,2) entry of \(A\operatorname{adj}A\).
questions.explanation: \(A\operatorname{adj}A=|A|I\) is a scalar matrix, so every off-diagonal entry is 0.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}-4&-6\\0&-1\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=(-4)(-1) - (-6)0=4\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: For the system \(\left\{\begin{aligned}x + 6y &= -23\\-5x - 3y &= 34\end{aligned}\right.\), find \(D_{y}\) (the determinant with the y-column replaced by the constants).
questions.explanation: \(D_{y}=\begin{vmatrix}1&-23\\-5&34\end{vmatrix}\) = -81.

questions.prompt: Is the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}2&6\\0&-2\end{bmatrix}\) singular or non-singular?
questions.explanation: \(|A|=2(-2) - 60=-4\). A matrix is singular when |A| = 0, so this matrix is non-singular.

questions.prompt: If A is a 4×4 matrix with \(|A|=-4\), find \(|3A|\).
A is 3×3 with \(|A|=6\). Find the (1,2) entry of \(A\operatorname{adj}A\).
questions.explanation: \(A\operatorname{adj}A=|A|I\) is a scalar matrix, so every off-diagonal entry is 0.

questions.prompt: In the order \(m\times n\) of a matrix, \(m\) stands for the number of:
questions.explanation: The order is written rows × columns, so \(m\) is the number of rows.

questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0&0\\1&1&0\\-6&-6&4\end{vmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: The matrix is lower triangular, so the determinant is the product of the diagonal entries: (-5) · 1 · 4 = -20.

questions.prompt: If A is a 4×4 matrix with \(|A|=-2\), find \(|2A|\).
Find the rank of \(A=\begin{bmatrix}5&-1\\7&3\end{bmatrix}\).
questions.explanation: Reduce to echelon form with row operations; the number of non-zero rows left is the rank. Here the rank is 2.
